pli-tv-bi-vb-pc82:1.2: tena kho pana samayena bhikkhuniyo anuvassaṃ vuṭṭhāpenti, upassayo na sammati.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc82:1.3: manussā vihāracārikaṃ āhiṇḍantā passitvā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc82:1.4: “kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo anuvassaṃ vuṭṭhāpessanti, upassayo na sammatī”ti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc82:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc82:1.6: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc82:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave, bhikkhuniyo anuvassaṃ vuṭṭhāpentīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc82:1.11: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhave, bhikkhuniyo anuvassaṃ vuṭṭhāpessanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc82:1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave, bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu:
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc82:2.1.9: vuṭṭhāpessāmīti gaṇaṃ vā ācariniṃ vā pattaṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā pariyesati, sīmaṃ vā sammannati āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc82:2.1.13: gaṇassa ca ācariniyā ca āpatti dukkaṭassa.
